Structured as a leaf text within the broader Paṭṭhāna matrix, it investigates the conditional relations between phenomena classified by combining the triad on visibility (*sanidassanattika*) with the dyad on impingement or reactivity (*sappaṭighaduka*) [SuttaCentral]. The available secondary literature contains no dedicated analysis or separate translation for this specific section [SuttaCentral].
